# Repository Instructions

## Verification

- After any code change: `bun run check`, `bun run knip`, `bun run lint`, `bun run format`, `bun run build`, `bun run test`.
- After any Actions change: `actionlint`, `ghalint run`, `ghalint run-action`, `zizmor`.
